skill.name: ddd-check
skill.description: Checks Java projects for Domain-Driven Design compliance in changed files or the full codebase. Reviews layer boundaries, base classes, naming, dependencies, and anti-patterns.
skill.summary: Review Java code for Domain-Driven Design structure, dependency direction, naming rules, and architectural anti-patterns.
skill.author: bookiosk

content.user_title: Review Java Projects for DDD Compliance
content.value_statement: Java architecture can drift across layers and weaken domain boundaries. This skill reviews changed files or full projects against detailed Domain-Driven Design rules.
actual_capabilities: Reviews changed Java files from git diff in incremental mode.
Audits all non-test Java files in full mode.
Checks package placement, base classes, naming, imports, and dependency direction.
Evaluates domain, application, adaptor, infrastructure, client, and model layers.
Reports prioritized violations with rule references and suggested fixes.
limitations: Applies the included opinionated DDD conventions, which may differ from project standards.
Does not compile code, run tests, or prove runtime behavior.
Relies on readable Java source and recognizable package structures.
Full audits may require substantial context for large repositories.

use_cases.title: Check Changes Before Commit
use_cases.description: Review changed Java files for DDD violations before creating a commit or pull request.

use_cases.title: Review Pull Request Architecture
use_cases.description: Identify dependency and layer violations introduced by a proposed Java change.

use_cases.title: Audit a Java Codebase
use_cases.description: Assess every production Java file and prioritize architectural improvements across all DDD layers.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Run an incremental DDD check on my changed Java files. Report only verified violations and include an exact fix for each issue.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Layer
prompt_templates.prompt: Review changed files in the {layer} layer. Check package placement, base classes, naming, imports, and relevant anti-patterns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review for a known architectural layer

prompt_templates.title: Audit the Full Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full DDD audit of this Java project. Group findings by layer, show dependency violations, and prioritize recommended fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Architecture Remediation
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the full project for DDD compliance. Build a phased remediation plan based on severity, dependency impact, and implementation effort.

output_examples.input: Check my changed Java files for DDD compliance.
output: Three changed Java files reviewed across domain and infrastructure layers.
High: Order imports an infrastructure Mapper. Move persistence access behind the domain repository interface.
Medium: OrderItem exposes a public identity setter. Change the setter to protected.

output_examples.input: Run a full architecture audit and prioritize the findings.
output: The audit groups findings by layer and reports the affected files.
Critical dependency violations appear first, followed by naming and structural issues.
The remediation plan addresses domain isolation before lower-impact convention changes.

best_practices: Use incremental mode for routine reviews and full mode for scheduled architecture audits.
Provide project-specific exceptions before the review begins.
Verify each suggested change against business rules and automated tests.
anti_patterns: Do not treat every convention difference as a production defect.
Do not apply fixes without checking project-specific architecture decisions.
Do not use incremental mode when evaluating repository-wide dependency direction.

faq.question: What projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Java projects organized with recognizable Domain-Driven Design layers and source packages.

faq.question: What is incremental mode?
faq.answer: Incremental mode reviews changed or newly added Java files reported by git diff.

faq.question: What is full mode?
faq.answer: Full mode reviews all production Java files and performs cross-layer architecture checks.

faq.question: Does the skill change source files?
faq.answer: No. It reports violations and suggests fixes without editing Java source.

faq.question: Does it run builds or tests?
faq.answer: No. The review is source-based and does not validate compilation or runtime behavior.

faq.question: Can I use custom DDD conventions?
faq.answer: You can provide explicit project exceptions, but the included rule files remain the primary review standard.
